basis.governing_question: How can Metalúrgica Norte cut conversion cost at its plant in Braga and put the improvements in place?

sub_questions.question: What is the current conversion cost per part at the Braga plant, and what drives it?
By how much can conversion cost per part fall, and which improvements deliver it?
How can the selected improvements be put in place on the plant floor and run there?
Does conversion cost per part fall by a measurable amount once the improvements are running?

drivers.evidence: One plant in Braga with 420 employees and three production lines.

work.unit: Site diagnosed on the floor (cost baseline, line observation, loss analysis)

phase_work.why: One site diagnosed on the floor, its lines observed within that unit, plus one start-up week and one synthesis week.

work.unit: Pilot site: changes made and savings shown in the cost data

phase_work.why: The single site is the pilot site, so no rollout wave follows; the estimate sits inside the typical 8 to 16 weeks.

sizing.levers: Fewer improvements carried into implementation, or changing the production lines at the same time, would shorten the engagement most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the plant's conversion cost per part, find what drives it, and size the improvement opportunities.

gate.label: Initiative go/no-go
gate.decision: Go/no-go on which sized improvements move into implementation?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Put the selected improvements in place at the plant and show the cost-per-part reduction in the cost data.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final results and the improvements now running at the plant?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given, so the 13 to 16 weeks is an estimate from the work, to be confirmed before quoting.
Implementation takes the middle of an 8 to 12 week estimate, and changing the lines one at a time would push it toward 12.
The one-site count comes from public research and needs client confirmation, and a second site would add a 4 to 6 week rollout wave.
No Measurement phase: cost per part is tracked inside Implementation, so confirm whether follow-up tracking after the improvements run is wanted.
